blocks.text: Scatterplots do variables ka rishta dikhate hain: har nuqta ek mushahida hai, apni do qeematon se rakha jata hai. Parhai ke ghanton banam exam scores ka scatterplot dikhata hai ke kya scores parhai ke waqt ke saath barhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Nuqton ka kaunsa andaaz musbat rishta dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Neeche baen se oopar daen barhte nuqte: ek variable barhe to doosra bhi barhta hai.

items: Scatterplot: har mushahide ka ek nuqta; ghante aur marks jaise rishte dikhata hai.
